quotes: Gate USDT perpetual 10s OHLC, using the corresponding 1m archive if the 10s block does not reproduce it. The two modeled high/low orders with 5s polling are sensitivity cases, not strict bounds. The 2019-12 trade archive and checked recent prints are replayed at their real timestamps. 15m bars aggregate observed prices, carrying the last price when a whole bar is unobserved. Unobserved minutes cannot fill simulated Gate orders.
year_end: Mark any open residual using the final quote. Original journals' artificial exit costs at the boundary are reversed.
same_market_own_original: Existing shared 500 USDT rules, each asset capped at 2.5x and portfolio at 5x, on the Gate data, with both assets eligible throughout the common window. Mark-to-market drawdown measured at 15m closes.

october_2026.sleeve_compounding_assumptions: Bar height is return on its sleeve before each trade. Only the 19 trades affect the month; no transfers, funding or boundary position revaluation.
